name: Foundry Work & Education Program (FWEP)
what_you_do: Get personalized one-on-one support to explore and reach your work and education goals. Help includes resumes, interviewing and managing stress. It is a support program, not a paid job.
who_can_apply: British Columbia youth ages 15 to 24 who want to work, go to school or start a training program and face barriers to doing so. You must be legally entitled to work in BC. You should not already be working, in school or in training, or be working less than 15 hours a week.
pay_detail: Free. This is job and school support, not a paid job. Foundry says all its services are free and confidential.
duration: Not stated on the pages read
deadline_text: No dates. Foundry says no referral is needed to use its services.
how_to_apply: Sign yourself up with the online Foundry Work & Education form linked on the Foundry services page. Or find a Foundry centre near you.
notes: Foundry also gives free and confidential mental health and wellness services for youth ages 12 to 24. WorkBC also lists this program. The British Columbia work rule is not verified for this card.
